facts.fact: The World Bank ID4D diagnostic (Portuguese edition) states that the Sistema Integrado de Gestão de Assentos (SIGA) was implemented in 2018, making digital registration of life events possible across the whole country, and that it now allows registration of all types of life events, in a civil registration system responsible for births, deaths, marriages and adoptions; it adds that birth registration data for 2010 to 2023 and data on other life events still need to be digitized and indexed in the centralized database.
facts.system: Sistema Integrado de Gestão de Assentos (SIGA)

facts.fact: The World Bank states that the Direcção Geral dos Registos e do Notariado (DGRN) is responsible for both civil registration and civil identification throughout the country and began digitalizing both systems in 2017 with support from INIC and Portugal's Instituto da Cooperação e da Língua.
